description: ONS mid-year population estimates for the 80+ age bands, split by sex, used by the age_tail stage to disaggregate the FRS age top-code. These are the same facts the calibration register binds as its ons.population.{sex}_{band} targets, recorded here so the imputation source and the target denominators share one source of truth; the values were read from the compiled national register at calibration year 2025 and the target_id recorded on each cell is the drift check.
source: Office for National Statistics, mid-year population estimates, via the chronicle ledger facts compiled into the UK national calibration register (target family ons_population).
